You have to remember that California and New York get a combined 86 electoral votes and whether 50.01% of the citizens vote for a candidate or 100% of them vote for a candidate, the winner will still get the same number of electoral votes. That's how Gore won the popular vote (because the overwhelming majority of California and New York vote Democrat) without winning the electoral vote.
